question: In which country was the FIG Apparatus World Cup 2025, where Pranati Nayak won bronze, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Turkey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **FIG Apparatus World Cup 2025** is an international gymnastics tournament organized by the **International Gymnastics Federation (FIG)**.
 
• In this competition, Indian gymnast **Pranati Nayak** secured a **bronze medal**, showcasing her exceptional talent and dedication in gymnastics.
 
• The event was held in **Turkey**, a country with a growing reputation for hosting international sporting events, particularly in gymnastics and athletics.
 
• This achievement marks an important milestone for Indian gymnastics on the global stage, highlighting the country’s progress in developing this sport.
 
• Pranati Nayak’s performance at the **FIG Apparatus World Cup** is a testament to her skill and perseverance, inspiring many young athletes in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pranati Nayak:**

 
 
• Pranati Nayak is an **Indian artistic gymnast** and one of the top gymnasts representing India internationally.
 
• She won a **bronze medal** at the 2019 Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships, further establishing her as a leading gymnast in the country.
 
• Pranati hails from the state of **West Bengal**, and her career has been supported by rigorous training and national-level coaching programs.
 
 
 
• **FIG Apparatus World Cup:**
 
 
• The **FIG Apparatus World Cup** is an annual gymnastics competition organized by the **International Gymnastics Federation (FIG)**.
 
• It is a prestigious event where gymnasts from around the world compete in different apparatus categories such as vault, uneven bars, balance beam, and floor exercises.
 
• The World Cup serves as a platform for gymnasts to earn valuable international rankings and prepare for other major tournaments like the **Olympics** and World Championships.
 
 
 
• **Turkey’s Role in Hosting Sports Events:**
 
 
• **Turkey** has emerged as a popular destination for hosting international sports events due to its world-class infrastructure and strategic location at the crossroads of Europe and Asia.
 
• It has previously hosted major events such as the **UEFA Champions League Final**, international tennis tournaments, and athletics championships.
 
• The country’s focus on promoting sports has enhanced its reputation in the global sports community.
 
 
 
• **Gymnastics in India:**
 
 
• Gymnastics is gaining popularity in India, with several young athletes making their mark on the international stage.
 
• Programs like the **Khelo India** initiative are promoting the development of gymnastics at the grassroots level.
 
• Indian gymnasts such as **Dipa Karmakar** and **Pranati Nayak** have played a significant role in bringing attention to the sport in the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **International Gymnastics Federation (FIG):**

 
 
• The **FIG** is the governing body for gymnastics worldwide, established in **1881**.
 
• It oversees various gymnastics disciplines, including artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, and trampoline gymnastics.
 
• Headquartered in **Lausanne, Switzerland**, the FIG is responsible for organizing events like the **World Gymnastics Championships** and FIG Apparatus World Cups.
 
 
 
• **Gymnastics Disciplines:**
 
 
• **Artistic Gymnastics**: Includes events like vault, uneven bars, balance beam, and floor exercises.
 
• **Rhythmic Gymnastics**: Combines dance, ballet, and gymnastics, often performed with apparatus like ribbons and hoops.
 
• **Trampoline Gymnastics**: Involves acrobatic movements performed on a trampoline.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Achievements in Gymnastics:**
 
 
• **Dipa Karmakar** made history by becoming the first Indian gymnast to qualify for the Olympics in 2016 and performing the **Produnova Vault**.
 
• India is gradually gaining recognition in gymnastics due to the efforts of athletes like Pranati Nayak and Dipa Karmakar.
